# JJ PRO

> JJ PRO is the boutique consulting practice of Jignesh P Jain, a Mumbai-based
> startup, GTM and fundraising consultant. JJ PRO partners with ambitious
> founders on brand strategy, fundraising, go-to-market and business
> transformation.

## About

- Founder: Jignesh P Jain — startup mentor and advisor to founders across
  multiple international accelerator and incubation programs, including
  Skolkovo (Russia), T3 Vakfı (Turkey), Wadhwani Foundation, IYESF, OIC
  International (Kazan, Tatarstan) and the Atal Incubation Centre (BIMTECH).
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Engagements are conducted globally
  and remotely.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jignesh1409/

## Services

- Brand Strategy — positioning, narrative and identity for early and
  growth-stage companies.
- Consulting — business transformation, virtual tech acceleration, D2C
  consulting.
- Fundraising — narrative, data room, investor targeting and close support.
- GTM — Cross Border — market entry playbooks for founders expanding into
  new geographies.
- Startup Coaching & Mentoring — ongoing 1:1 advisory for founders.
